title: Harden the completed-only opt-out recovery remap against wrapped errors and pin its predecessor half
outcome: Harden the completed-only opt-out recovery remap against wrapped errors and pin its predecessor half
acceptance: The opt-out recovery remap from the completed-only marker to the enable-task-sync remedy matches the marker by type, or by root cause, instead of the outer display string, so a .context() added between read_selected and the remap keeps the remedy; a test wraps the marker in context and still sees the exact enable-task-sync text

A regression covers a retained two-generation history whose latest generation is completed and whose earlier generation lacks its completion marker, asserting the exact original pending-recovery refusal and an unchanged fixture (paths and bytes) and store

completion.summary: Hardened completed-only opt-out recovery with a typed marker that survives wrapped errors, while preserving the original pending-recovery refusal whenever a predecessor remains pending. Landed after the exact-tree full gate, clean review pair, independent 2/2 acceptance evaluation, pre- and post-commit six-store readiness, and installation of the committed release binary.
